notes: PleaToken is a fixed-supply ERC-20 named plea (PLEA), with 18 decimals. Its argument-free constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 PLEA once to msg.sender, the launch factory. Transfers have no fees. There are no owner or admin privileges, subsequent minting, burning, or application contracts. The pool pairs with IMD at a 1.25% fee and tick spacing 60. pool.initialPrice records provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and the token's total supply.
